name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Bichlhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Bichlhof is situated in Thiersee in the Kufstein district, offering spacious holiday apartments within an authentic farm setting. It is perfectly tailored for self-catering travellers who value countryside tranquillity and genuine nature. The adjoining working farm is home to animals, which guests are warmly invited to help care for. The well-appointed apartments feature separate living and sleeping areas for optimal comfort. Thiersee borders Bavaria and is renowned for the scenic Lake Thiersee, ideal for swimming. The location is perfect for mountain excursions, trips to historic Kufstein, and visits to the Bavarian Inn Valley.
